proposed_text: Alberta DERS gas Oct 2026 $1.458/GJ (UCA default rates, ATCO Gas area); ATCO Gas North Mid Use variable delivery $1.045/GJ (ATCO Gas North Rate Schedules, p. 11, eff. 1 Jan 2026; riders T $1.289/GJ and L $0.087/GJ not included) → ≈ $11/MWh heat (? conversion not re-checked) — https://www.ucahelps.alberta.ca/regulated-rates.aspx ; https://gas.atco.com/content/dam/web/for-home/natural-gas/natural-gas-north-rate-schedule.pdf
number_change: ATCO Mid Use delivery 1.062 → 1.045 $/GJ. Sum 2.520 → 2.503 $/GJ (≈0.7% lower). The ≈$11/MWh heat figure probably still rounds to 11, but its conversion (efficiency assumed) was not in the source and was not checked.
note: The schedule was read via WebFetch (summarising tool); values were consistent across two fetches. If the tool means full delivery cost, adding riders T and L gives 1.045 + 1.289 + 0.087 = 2.421 $/GJ, plus a fixed $1.909/day - that would change the price ceiling a lot. Mid Use caps at 8,000 GJ/yr, so a larger heat buyer would be on High Use. Cover date on the PDF differs between search title (July 1, 2026) and fetch (August 1, 2026); the Mid Use rate is effective 1 Jan 2026 either way.
